prompt:
Write the file `models/marts/schema.yml` for the repository "pantry-dbt".

Stack: dbt, BigQuery, Fivetran, SQL
Purpose of this file: dbt tests and column descriptions for the orders mart
Project context: A dbt project with staging, intermediate and mart layers for orders, subscriptions and marketing.

Requirements:
- 25 to 70 lines of realistic, plausible code in the right language for the file extension.
- A few short comments, no long docstrings, no secrets or real credentials.
- Output only the file contents, without Markdown fences.
text:
version: 2

models:
  - name: fct_orders
    description: Mart table for customer orders used in reporting and analysis.
    columns:
      - name: order_id
        description: Unique identifier for each order.
        tests:
          - not_null
          - unique
      - name: customer_id
        description: Identifier for the customer associated with the order.
        tests:
          - not_null
      - name: order_created_at
        description: Timestamp when the order was created.
        tests:
          - not_null
      - name: order_status
        description: Current status of the order.
      - name: order_total
        description: Total order amount in the source currency.
      - name: currency_code
        description: ISO currency code for the order total.
      - name: source_system
        description: System that provided the order record.
      - name: updated_at
        description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the order record.

  - name: dim_orders
    description: Dimension table for order-level attributes and descriptive fields.
    columns:
      - name: order_id
        description: Unique identifier for each order.
        tests:
          - not_null
          - unique
      - name: customer_id
        description: Identifier for the customer associated with the order.
        tests:
          - not_null
      - name: order_date
        description: Date the order was created.
      - name: fulfillment_status
        description: Fulfillment state used in operational reporting.
      - name: payment_status
        description: Payment state used in operational reporting.
      - name: channel
        description: Sales channel associated with the order.
      - name: is_first_order
        description: Flag indicating whether the order is the customer's first order.
      - name: is_refunded
        description: Flag indicating whether the order has been refunded.
